title: From Phytochemistry to Metabolic Regulation: The Insulin-Promoting Effects of Loureirin B Analogous to an Agonist of GLP-1 Receptor.
authors: Fang, Haowen; Sun, Xiaodong; Ding, Yanting; Gu, Siyuan; Niu, Bing; Chen, Qin
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦小分子LB-A与GLP-1受体互作及降糖机制，对象为蛋白-小分子体系，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to develop a potent, safe, and cost-effective small-molecule hypoglycemic agent derived from Loureirin B, with preliminary evaluation of its efficacy and mechanistic underpinnings. Thirty structural analogs of Loureirin B were synthesized. Molecular docking identified LB-A as the lead compound targeting GLP-1R. Its hypoglycemic activity was initially assessed in a murine model. Molecular dynamics simulations, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), and circular dichroism (CD) were employed to characterize LB-A-GLP-1R interactions. The involvement of the GLP-1R/cAMP/PKA pathway and downstream mediators was examined using cellular assays, gene knockout, and Western blotting, with emphasis on FOXO1. LB-A exhibited the strongest binding affinity for GLP-1R among the analogs and significantly reduced blood glucose levels in mice. It formed hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions with key residues (e.g., LYS197) and induced conformational changes in GLP-1R. LB-A activation of GLP-1R upregulated cAMP, PKA, and pCREB, suppressed PTEN/FOXO1 signaling, and subsequently stimulated insulin secretion. LB-A represents a novel small molecule agonist that ameliorates hyperglycemia in diabetic mice through specific activation of the GLP-1R/cAMP/PKA/pCREB/PTEN/FOXO1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在开发一种来源于龙血素B（Loureirin B）的高效、安全且经济的小分子降糖药物，并初步评估其疗效及机制基础。合成了三十种龙血素B的结构类似物。分子对接（molecular docking）确定LB-A为靶向GLP-1R的先导化合物。其降糖活性首先在小鼠模型中进行了初步评估。采用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和圆二色谱（CD）来表征LB-A与GLP-1R的相互作用。通过细胞实验、基因敲除和Western blotting检测了GLP-1R/cAMP/PKA通路及下游介质的参与，重点关注FOXO1。LB-A在类似物中表现出对GLP-1R最强的结合亲和力，并显著降低小鼠血糖水平。它与关键残基（如LYS197）形成氢键和疏水相互作用，并诱导GLP-1R构象变化。LB-A激活GLP-1R上调cAMP、PKA和pCREB，抑制PTEN/FOXO1信号通路，进而刺激胰岛素分泌。LB-A代表一种新型小分子激动剂，通过特异性激活GLP-1R/cAMP/PKA/pCREB/PTEN/FOXO1通路改善糖尿病小鼠的高血糖状态。
